themes.name: Housing Affordability and Upgrades
themes.rule: Proposals that create, preserve, make transparent, or improve affordable housing, including student housing, conversions, inclusionary requirements, rent information, and energy retrofits.

themes.name: Education and Youth Support
themes.rule: Proposals that improve schools or directly support children’s learning, nutrition, teachers, school facilities, or arts education.

themes.name: Healthcare and Aging Services
themes.rule: Proposals that expand medical access, preventive care, mental-health care, specialist access, or support for older residents living at home.

themes.name: Public Transit Services
themes.rule: Proposals that make bus or public-transit travel more frequent, affordable, available at more hours, or easier to track.

themes.name: Digital Civic Access
themes.rule: Proposals that improve residents’ access to municipal information, online services, service requests, public data, or public internet connectivity.

themes.name: Environmental Sustainability and Green Space
themes.rule: Proposals that reduce pollution or waste, expand renewable energy or recycling, monitor environmental conditions, or create urban greenery and food-growing spaces.

themes.name: Local Jobs and Small Business
themes.rule: Proposals that support employment, worker retraining, local hiring, business licensing, small-business finance, or workspaces for independent workers.

themes.name: Culture, Libraries, and Recreation
themes.rule: Proposals that expand cultural participation, public arts, festivals, museum access, library access, or recreational amenities such as dog areas.

themes.name: Public Safety and Emergency Response
themes.rule: Proposals that prevent crime or traffic danger, improve street lighting, strengthen neighborhood policing, add surveillance, or shorten fire and ambulance response times.

themes.name: Accessible Active Public Spaces
themes.rule: Proposals that make public outdoor facilities more accessible for people with disabilities or enable safe non-motorized travel, such as protected cycling infrastructure.
